X3_yields.note: compilation conflicts (Krause & Oliver via xraydb/Elam vs EPDL97 — the known heavy-Z L3 split) are LISTED IN FULL and capped at 2; the omega+Auger identity is exact within our data, and the round-trip battery measures the forward model's self-consistency (it does NOT validate the yield edition — both sides share it)

honesty.REAL: cross-edition checks (X1 edges, X2 lines, X3 yields): our tables vs a different published edition of the same classical data; deviations reported in full
honesty.REGRESSION_GUARDS: X4 (mu/rho) and X5 (PyMca bindings) are SAME-SOURCE guards: our tables carry the xraydb/Elam lineage, numerically identical to xraylib's mu table (5e-8) and PyMca's binding table (bitwise) — they catch transcription/interpolation regressions, NOT edition choice
honesty.MODEL: declared cross-compilation tolerances; excluded scopes (sub-1000 eV edges, sub-1e-2 yields) spoken
honesty.ABSENT: a package not installed is SPOKEN, never faked, and the battery runs on what exists
honesty.HARDWARE: none — both pulled packages are data + math only
